# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_ALIGNMENT_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price crosses above VWAP while the EMA ribbon is bearish (EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55) and forms a strong upper-wick rejection candle (high - close > 2 × (close - low)), it signals a false breakout and a short opportunity. This pattern captures failed bullish momentum in choppy, elevated volatility regimes, exploiting mean reversion after VWAP resistance tests.

## Mechanism

Entry: If close > VWAP AND EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55 AND (high - close) > 2 × (close - low) AND volume > 10-bar average volume, enter short at the bar's close.  
Exit: Chart-stop at the high of the entry bar, initial target at 1×ATR below entry, with a trailing stop of 0.5×ATR activated after 0.5×ATR profit is achieved.  
Regime filters: Only active when ADX < 20 (choppy) AND VIX > 20 (elevated volatility), and avoids the first 15 minutes after open (09:30-09:45 ET) to reduce noise.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and 3-contract minimum.
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical samples tested; proposal based solely on price action theory. High overfit risk until validated via Stage-1 backtest.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out testing performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic slippage/spread simulation on OPRA data).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Sustained upward breakout after VWAP cross (e.g., strong trend day) causing large short losses.
   - Max drawdown: Unknown; could exceed 50% per-trade risk if stops fail to execute during gaps.
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility expansion (VIX > 30) with persistent upward momentum invalidating mean-reversion assumption.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown; requires backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L.
